Calibrate a shape-parameter intervention (deprecated)

Source: R/deprecated.R
calibration.fun.Rd

calibration.fun() is deprecated as of MultiStateTMLE 0.1.0. Use calibrate_alpha() instead.

Usage

calibration.fun(
  initial.fit = NULL,
  a = NULL,
  theta = 0.5,
  rho = NULL,
  delta = NULL,
  rho.1a = NULL,
  browse = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  output.eic = FALSE,
  tau = 1.2,
  tau.z = tau,
  use.cores = 1,
  target = "outcome",
  z.name = "z",
  ...
)

Arguments

initial.fit

See initial_fit in calibrate_alpha().

tau, tau.z, browse

Ignored; the horizon is that of initial.fit.

use.cores

See cores in calibrate_alpha().

target, a, theta, rho, delta, verbose

See calibrate_alpha(). theta is ignored if rho, delta or rho.1a is given.

z.name, rho.1a, output.eic

See the snake_case equivalents in calibrate_alpha().

...

Passed on to tmle_alpha(), with dotted argument names translated to their snake_case equivalents.

Value

See calibrate_alpha().
